title: Ordered Permutations
statementMd:
Consider a permutation$^{\text{∗}}$ $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$ of integers from $1$ to $n$. We can introduce the following sum for it$^{\text{†}}$:

$$S(p) = \sum_{1 \le l \le r \le n} \min(p_l, p_{l + 1}, \ldots, p_r)$$

Let us consider all permutations of length $n$ with the maximum possible value of $S(p)$. Output the $k$-th of them in lexicographical$^{\text{‡}}$order, or report that there are less than $k$ of them.

$^{\text{∗}}$A permutation of length $n$ is an array consisting of $n$ distinct integers from $1$ to $n$ in arbitrary order. For example, $[2,3,1,5,4]$ is a permutation, but $[1,2,2]$ is not a permutation ($2$ appears twice in the array), and $[1,3,4]$ is also not a permutation ($n=3$ but there is $4$ in the array). $^{\text{†}}$For example: For the permutation $[1, 2, 3]$ the value of $S(p)$ is equal to $\min(1) + \min(1, 2) + \min(1, 2, 3) + \min(2) + \min(2, 3) + \min(3) =$ $1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 + 3 = 10$ For the permutation $[2, 4, 1, 3]$ the value of $S(p)$ is equal to $\min(2) + \min(2, 4) + \min(2, 4, 1) + \min(2, 4, 1, 3) \ +$ $ \min(4) + \min(4, 1) + \min(4, 1, 3) \ +$ $\min(1) + \min(1, 3) \ +$ $\min(3) =$ $2 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 4 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 3 = 17$. $^{\text{‡}}$An array $a$ is lexicographically smaller than an array $b$ if and only if one of the following holds: $a$ is a prefix of $b$, but $a \ne b$; or in the first position where $a$ and $b$ differ, the array $a$ has a smaller element than the corresponding element in $b$.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

The only line of each test case contains two integers $n$ and $k$ ($1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$; $1 \le k \le 10^{12}$) — the length of the permutation and the index number of the desired permutation.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2 \cdot 10 ^ 5$.

## Output

For each test case, if there are less than $k$ suitable permutations, print $-1$.

Otherwise, print the $k$-th suitable permutation.

## Note

Let us calculate the required sum for all permutations of length $3$ (ordered lexicographically):

PermutationValue of $S(p)$$[1, 2, 3]$$10$$[1, 3, 2]$$10$$[2, 1, 3]$$9$$[2, 3, 1]$$10$$[3, 1, 2]$$9$$[3, 2, 1]$$10$

In the first test case, you have to print the second suitable permutation of length $3$. Looking at the table, we see that it is the permutation $[1, 3, 2]$.

In the second test case, you have to print the third suitable permutation of length $3$. Looking at the table, we see that it is the permutation $[2, 3, 1]$.
statementZhMd:
考虑一个由 $1$ 到 $n$ 的整数组成的排列$^{\text{∗}}$ $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$。我们可以为它引入如下求和$^{\text{†}}$：

$$S(p) = \sum_{1 \le l \le r \le n} \min(p_l, p_{l + 1}, \ldots, p_r)$$

让我们考虑所有长度为 $n$ 且 $S(p)$ 的值达到最大可能值的排列。按字典序$^{\text{‡}}$输出其中第 $k$ 个排列；如果这样的排列不足 $k$ 个，则报告不存在。

$^{\text{∗}}$长度为 $n$ 的排列是一个由 $1$ 到 $n$ 的 $n$ 个互不相同的整数按任意顺序组成的数组。例如，$[2,3,1,5,4]$ 是一个排列，但 $[1,2,2]$ 不是排列（$2$ 在数组中出现了两次），$[1,3,4]$ 也不是排列（$n=3$ 但数组中有 $4$）。$^{\text{†}}$例如：对于排列 $[1, 2, 3]$，$S(p)$ 的值等于 $\min(1) + \min(1, 2) + \min(1, 2, 3) + \min(2) + \min(2, 3) + \min(3) =$ $1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 + 3 = 10$；对于排列 $[2, 4, 1, 3]$，$S(p)$ 的值等于 $\min(2) + \min(2, 4) + \min(2, 4, 1) + \min(2, 4, 1, 3) \ +$ $ \min(4) + \min(4, 1) + \min(4, 1, 3) \ +$ $\min(1) + \min(1, 3) \ +$ $\min(3) =$ $2 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 4 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 3 = 17$。$^{\text{‡}}$当且仅当满足下列条件之一时，数组 $a$ 的字典序小于数组 $b$：$a$ 是 $b$ 的前缀但 $a \ne b$；或在 $a$ 与 $b$ 首个不同的位置上，数组 $a$ 的元素小于数组 $b$ 中对应位置的元素。

## 输入格式

每个测试文件包含多组测试数据。第一行包含测试数据的组数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各组测试数据的描述。

每组测试数据仅一行，包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $k$（$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$；$1 \le k \le 10^{12}$）——分别表示排列的长度和目标排列的序号。

保证所有测试数据的 $n$ 之和不超过 $2 \cdot 10 ^ 5$。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试数据，如果满足条件的排列不足 $k$ 个，输出 $-1$。

否则，输出第 $k$ 个满足条件的排列。

## 说明

我们来计算长度为 $3$ 的所有排列所对应的和（按字典序排列）：

| 排列 | $S(p)$ 的值 |
| --- | --- |
| $[1, 2, 3]$ | $10$ |
| $[1, 3, 2]$ | $10$ |
| $[2, 1, 3]$ | $9$ |
| $[2, 3, 1]$ | $10$ |
| $[3, 1, 2]$ | $9$ |
| $[3, 2, 1]$ | $10$ |

在第一组测试数据中，需要输出长度为 $3$ 的第二个满足条件的排列。查看表格可知，它是排列 $[1, 3, 2]$。

在第二组测试数据中，需要输出长度为 $3$ 的第三个满足条件的排列。查看表格可知，它是排列 $[2, 3, 1]$。
